deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Location check: visually confirm the switch (location) is in the correct labeled position on the chassis. A physical/visual placement check of a board switch; the agent cannot see or touch the switch.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator inspects the switch and confirms its location is correct per the label; agent cannot physically locate or view the switch.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. Correct visual boundary but refers generically to a chassis label rather than proving the motherboard reference against the exact drawing.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED. V2 distinguishes location from function and adds board revision, switch identity, visual evidence and no-toggle controls.
historical_reviews.v3: No V3 Pilot record exists for this source key.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No V3.1 200-case record exists for this source key.

original_test_intent: Verify the specified physical switch is installed at the correct motherboard location for the exact system and board revision, without toggling or moving it.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the board and switch reference, visually locates it using the approved drawing/label map, photographs the location and records expected-versus-observed placement while leaving its state unchanged.
manual_activity: Physical location relative to board landmarks and silkscreen must be visually inspected by an operator. Remote firmware status cannot prove installation location.
required_inputs: Switch reference designator, board drawing and expected location/label
Approved powered-off/discharged access and ESD procedure
Lighting/photo method, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Use the approved chassis power state and ESD controls.
Do not touch, toggle or reposition the switch during this location-only audit.
Stop on wrong revision, missing label, ambiguous drawing, obstruction or damaged hardware.
Preserve evidence and leave mismatches unchanged for separate disposition.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only platform/board identity and supporting health baselines.
Prepare the expected-versus-observed photo checklist and verify evidence completeness.
Do not infer location, request a toggle or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Supply the switch drawing/reference and safe access procedure.
Perform and record the physical visual comparison.
Disposition any mismatch separately and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The no-command physical boundary is correct, but motherboard drawing/reference evidence—not merely a chassis label—is needed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain visual inspection and use software only for board identity corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: System-spec and motherboard location comparison plus both five-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN VISUAL LOCATION AUDIT WITH BOARD-LANDMARK EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a wide board-context image and a close switch/reference image tied to a revision-controlled drawing, without manipulating the device.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact motherboard revision and switch assembly.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board assembly and drawing/specification revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner motherboard switch-location drawing and system specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable identity and visual context without converting the case into a function test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; only physical location is evaluated.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board revision, switch reference and drawing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A close-up without board landmarks can be valid-looking but mapped to the wrong location.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define the evidence format but must compare the correct switch on the exact board revision. Switch state or function belongs to separate cases and is not inferred here.
expected_evidence: Board/drawing revisions, switch reference/location and authorization
Timestamped wide-context and close-up physical evidence with labels
Expected-versus-observed location record and no-toggle confirmation
Restored chassis/health state and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently ask for a location comparison; missing switch identity and drawing are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The owner can supply the exact drawing and an operator can inspect the board; this is MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO but correct the evidence basis to motherboard drawing/reference.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and location-only/no-toggle scope.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Prevents switch function or remote state from being substituted for placement proof.

review_improvement: Requires enough board context and revision provenance to prove that the inspected component is the intended switch at the intended location.
independent_technical_reasoning: Location is a physical construction attribute. Board identity can be read electronically, but only a qualified visual inspection tied to the drawing can verify placement, making the case MANUAL ONLY.
